content.comment_body: How can I configure a variable timer based on the pulse count from a high-speed input?
Hello, you can use a counter block as a reference within the timer settings. If you need to perform calculations using your counter value, a mathematical instruction can be set as the reference.
[user_name], I've found it challenging to apply your suggestion. Do you have any diagrams or examples you could share?
Check the attached example. Notice Block B002: the 'Reference' is set to Block 001 (Counter). This program serves as a starting point for you.
Hello, please take a look at the attached sample for further guidance.
Thanks to both of you! I didn't realize the approach was so simple. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users discussed configuring a variable timer that responds to pulse counts from a high-speed input. Initially, one user was unsure about referencing the counter value for the timer, but received guidance and example programs from others. This exchange demonstrated that providing visual references or documentation greatly helps users understand and implement these features efficiently.
